chunks: He narrated to me from one who asked Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام.
About a man who prays in a single garment, wrapping himself with it, he said: “There is no problem with it if he raises it up to the breasts.”

key_terms.الثَّدْيَيْنِ: the two breasts; the chest area
key_terms.ثَوْبٍ: a garment or piece of clothing
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no problem; it is permissible
key_terms.يَأْتَزِرُ: he wraps himself with it like a waist-wrapper

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform salat (prayer) in a single garment?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding salat (prayer) in a single garment. It indicates that praying in one wrapped cloth is permissible when it is raised sufficiently to cover the body up to the chest area.
